description: This Java source file defines the ConnectionUnavailableException class, a specific type of exception used in the connectivity components of the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that a connection exists but is not currently available, providing constructors and builder patterns for creating instances of this exception. It also includes methods for constructing exceptions from messages or JSON objects, with relevant metadata and imports.

classes.name: ConnectionUnavailableException
classes.description: Represents an exception indicating that a specific connection is not available at the moment. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ConnectivityException, providing static methods and a builder for creating instances with detailed context.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing ConnectionUnavailableException instances. It allows setting message, description, cause, href, and ultimately building the exception object.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing a ConnectionUnavailableException based on a connection ID.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs a ConnectionUnavailableException from a provided message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ConnectionUnavailableException from a JSON object and headers, parsing the relevant error details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
